## Objective and purpose

## Scope and non-goals

## Context and constraints

## Completion criteria

## Delivery and verification

Explain the intended approach and how the combined result will be assessed. Add stories using GitHub's native sub-issue relationships; do not maintain a second child-story checklist here. Child closure alone does not demonstrate the epic's completion criteria.

## Lasting records

Identify the current guidance and durable research or decisions this epic should produce.
